sn35.20:1.1: Yo bhikkhave rūpe abhinandati dukkhaṃ so abhinandati ||
sn35.20:1.2: yo dukkham abhinandati Aparimutto so dukkhasmā ti vadāmi || ||
sn35.20:1.8: yo dukkham abhinandati Aparimutto so dukkhasmā ti vadāmi || || 3
sn35.20:2.1: Yo ca kho bhikkhave rūpe nābhinandati dukkhaṃ so nābhinandati ||
sn35.20:2.2: yo dukkhaṃ nābhinandati Parimutto so dukkhasmā ti vadāmi || ||
sn35.20:2.8: yo dukkhaṃ nābhinandati Parimutto so dukkhasmā ti vadāmī
